page.overview:
Who is Kotoha Hashibira?

Kotoha was a young woman of petite build and fair skin complexion. Her large emerald green eyes were framed by long black eyelashes, she had thin black eyebrows, a small nose, and pink lips. Her beauty was apparent as it made a lasting impression on even the apathetic Doma; her son Inosuke, who is also noted to be attractive by several people, was described as being strikingly similar to her by the demon, though Kotoha had softer features. She wore her long, black hair that was tied in a bun at the end.

Before she was taken in by the Eternal Paradise Faith, Kotoha only wore a tattered gray kimono with black line as a design and torn in several spots. When she became acquainted with Doma, she wore a lime green kimono to replaced her old one, decorated with darker green floral patterns and tied with a black obi. When she fled the cult, Kotoha was last seen wearing a similar lime green kimono, only this was decorated with lines and squares, and tied with a forest green obi.

Kotoha was a kind and loving woman, always showing appreciation to those around her. She treasured Inosuke dearly and would always sing lullabies to him when he was a baby, promising to always protect him no matter what. When meeting Doma, she found a fond liking in him due to him helping her escape the abuse she was facing from her family.

According to Doma, Kotoha was naive and not very smart. Doma describes her as a "beautiful" but innocent person. It's unknown whether he exaggerated her low intelligence due to his patronizing view of humans or if her kind nature coupled with the fact that she was partially blind from the beatings she endured from her husband made her ignorant to Doma's true nature. Quite contradictory however, Doma also claimed that she was also sharp despite her supposed stupidity, and that is how she found out about him being a demon who devoured his followers.
